seasons.title: Foundations
seasons.description: The beginning of an inward journey

episodes.title: The Jedi, The Platypus, and Vulnerable Transparency
episodes.description: A session exploring the difficulty of direct communication and the 'miracle trap' of wanting needs met without asking. The dialogue reframes vulnerability as a skill requiring practice, not a weakness to overcome.

episodes.title: The Miracle Trap: Idealism, Will, and Vulnerability
episodes.description: An intensive debate on the belief that true connection requires telepathic unity without verbal communication. The session explores the friction between metaphysical idealism and psychological pragmatism.

episodes.title: Becoming the Source: A Study in Liberated Will
episodes.description: A transformative session on emotional dependency and the Will to Power. The client realizes that true strength lies not in forcing change, but in maintaining an unshakeable, truthful self.

episodes.title: The Anatomy of Trust and Relational Splitting
episodes.description: A session processing intense distrust triggered by perceived dishonesty in a relationship. The dialogue traces the struggle to reconcile a partner's image with betrayal.

episodes.title: The Great Split: Truth, Trust, and the Social Game
episodes.description: A session on profound distrust and the fear of showing one's true self. The dialogue reveals a 'Great Split' between the vulnerable Child self and the powerful Emperor self.

episodes.title: White Room to the World
episodes.description: A transformative session exploring the journey from isolation to connection. The dialogue examines the transition from internal sanctuary to authentic engagement with the external world.
